basis: Parent supplied installed primary help confirms save-graph-to is context-only and actual graph export uses dump-json-graph plus dump-graph-to-file. Child direct help attempt failed before help due sandbox log directory permissions.
behavior: Production build and graph-only export have distinct records; a graph-only successful exit is never accepted as a production build.
Export preserves normalized production arguments, relwithdebinfo, authorized8workers, and memory-safe-build helper hash.
Graph record binds clean revision before/after, profile, successful immutable build.json hash, configuration, exact export arguments, graph file identity, and guarded exit metrics.
Capture validates graph record against the successful build and graph identity; receipt binds the graph record for later revalidation.
Export-graph command permits graph-only retry from a saved successful build record.
Current legacy C31 build.json needs an explicit reviewed configuration recovery binding before this stricter path accepts it; successful build must not be rerun merely to migrate metadata.
limits: Actual graph-only invocation still pending parent verification.
Only explicit build configuration and builder helper bytes are bound; this proposal does not add a new ambient-environment or user-config snapshot system.
No automatic migration or relaxation for older incomplete build records.
